# Monfort Kitchens

> Monfort is a sink manufacturer in Delhi, making kitchen sinks and bathroom accessories since 2000. We manufacture Indian, handmade, premium handmade, waterfall and quartz kitchen sinks, along with a wide range of bathroom accessories, from our own production unit in Bawana Industrial Area, Delhi. Our products are supplied through 6,000+ dealers across India, and we accept homeowner, dealer, distributor and bulk/project orders.

Key facts:
- Founded: 2000
- Location: G-108, Sector-3, Bawana Industrial Area, Delhi-110039, India
- Phone: +91-9871667213 / +91-8383972282
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM–7:00 PM

## Kitchen Sinks

- [Kitchen Sinks Overview](https://www.kitchensinkmanufacturers.com/products/kitchen-sinks): All kitchen sink categories in one place.
- [Handmade Sink](https://www.kitchensinkmanufacturers.com/products/handmade): Premium handmade stainless steel sinks in Matt, Nano Black, Gold, Mirror and Rose Gold finishes.
- [Indian Sink](https://www.kitchensinkmanufacturers.com/products/indian-sink): Everyday stainless steel sinks with a glossy finish for regular family use.
- [PTMT Taps](https://www.kitchensinkmanufacturers.com/products/ptmt-taps): Durable, lightweight PTMT taps for smooth water flow.
- [Waterfall Sinks](https://www.kitchensinkmanufacturers.com/products/waterfall): Designer sinks with an integrated waterfall-style water outlet.
- [Premium Handmade Kitchen Sink](https://www.kitchensinkmanufacturers.com/products/premium-handmade): High-grade handmade sinks with superior finishing.
- [Quartz Sink](https://www.kitchensinkmanufacturers.com/products/quartz-sink): Premium quartz and Metallic & Granite series sinks in Black, Brown, Gray, Ivory Sand, Red Moon, Peach Ivory and more.
